title: UniV4 Private Wallet
tagline: Keep and send your stables  with Uniswap V4. Yield  as LP provider
description: Most of stable coins operating with entities so any address can be Banned (Blacklisted).   With this solution, granny Alice can still store and send her stables to old Bob without fear of being blocked. Observed sender will be Proxy Smart Wallet (not Alice EOA). Addition bonus available as well as Uniswap LP
how_its_made: The solution is based on the unique liquidity management model in Uniswap V4. Instead of storing liquidity in their EOA, users are asked to open a position in V4 and store it in a separate smart wallet. An account abstraction () is used to easily create a position and smart wallet (Uniswap smart wallet implementation)
